limitations: Headless Luau/Core replay only; does not replay browser/native rendering or external services.
Checkpoint, automatic capture, registry/trace storage and schema migrations are not implemented.
Full GC sampling changes collection scheduling; compare it separately from ordinary playback.
Explicit full GC changes collection scheduling and weak references; run on a diagnostic session, not an unmodified timing baseline.
Sampled peak is not a continuous high-water mark. Full GC wall time includes instrumentation; it is not CPU time.
Use identical phase labels only for comparable seed/input/workloads; warmup samples are excluded. Cache growth is not proof of a leak.
History is VM-local and reset by hot reload; export reports with project/build/asset fingerprints before comparing runs.
memory.scope: main Luau VM only; excludes worker VMs, Rust, JS, WASM allocator and GPU

notes: wall clock timings, excluded from the observation digest
THIS IS A DEBUG BUILD. These are debug costs and are not a shipping measurement; rebuild with --release before drawing a conclusion.
serialize is an optional canonical-JSON probe, not actual Web publication or decode time; measure those separately
luau_positive_heap_delta_bytes_per_frame is positive net heap growth, not total allocated bytes or GC pause attribution
median, p95, and frames-over-budget use the most recent bounded sample window (up to 1024 frames)

window.semantics: VM-safe-point sample counts, not exact function milliseconds or call counts. Native calls and GC are not asynchronously sampled. Short functions, inlining and safe-point placement can bias attribution; compare with sampling disabled.

vm.allocation_method: Luau onallocate: sum(max(new_size-old_size,0)) on successful requests; excludes frees, allocator overhead and Rust/JS allocations
vm.gc_method: Luau paired incremental-step interrupts; includes automatic assists, excludes full collections; timing includes instrumentation overhead
vm.scope: Luau update call, including engine callbacks; manual tools and load/start are excluded

value.samplingScope: Luau gameplay; replay adapter callbacks are excluded from function sampling. VM allocation/GC metrics cover update only.
